NetworkRxBytes

Meaningful Statistics: Average, Minimum, Maximum, Sum

Unit info: Bytes/Second

panels.description:
EphemeralStorageUtilized

The number of bytes used from ephemeral storage in the resource that is specified by the dimensions that you're using. Ephemeral storage is used for the container root filesystem and any bind mount host volumes defined in the container image and task definition. The amount of ephemeral storage can’t be changed in a running task. This metric is only available for tasks that run on Fargate Linux platform version 1.4.0 or later.

Meaningful Statistics: Average, Minimum, Maximum

Unit info: Gigabytes (GB)

targets.expression: SELECT SUM(EphemeralStorageUtilized) FROM SCHEMA("ECS/ContainerInsights", ClusterName) GROUP BY ClusterName
